rationale: C09 is an immediately preceding annual instance of the same Midyear Economic Report transmittal letter. The child reproduces its addressees, paragraph sequence, statutory citations, institutional participants, and nearly all operative wording, changing principally the report dates and titles from 1951 to 1952. C24 and C18 are likewise clear earlier iterations, but C09 is temporally closest and offers the strongest plausible drafting template.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am presenting herewith a Midyear Economic Report to the Congress. This is supplementary to the Economic Report of the President of January 16, 1952, and is transmitted in accordance with section 3 (b) of the Employment Act of 1946.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am presenting herewith a Midyear Economic Report to the Congress. This is supplementary to the Economic Report of the President of January 12, 1951, and is transmitted in accordance with section 3 (b) of the Employment Act of 1946.
shared_material.explanation: The core transmittal sentence is effectively identical, with only the annual report date changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In preparing this report, I have had the advice and assistance of the Council of Economic Advisers, members of the Cabinet, and heads of independent agencies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In preparing this report, I have had the advice and assistance of the Council of Economic Advisers, members of the Cabinet, and heads of independent agencies.
shared_material.explanation: This entire sentence is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Together with this report, I am transmitting a report, the Midyear 1952 Economic Review, prepared for me by the Council of Economic Advisers in accordance with section 4 (c) (2) of the Employment Act of 1946.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Together with this report, I am transmitting a report, The Economic Situation at Midyear 1951, prepared for me by the Council of Economic Advisers in accordance with section 4 (c) (2) of the Employment Act of 1946.
shared_material.explanation: The same closing transmittal machinery and statutory authority are retained, with the accompanying report's annual title updated.
